title: Yellow Chrysanthemums and Red Osmanthus in the Style of Wang Yuan（1997.100）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1997.100）
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1468」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Yellow Chrysanthemums and Red Osmanthus in the Style of Wang Yuan
Bequest of Mrs. A. Dean Perry

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → ming；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

Dubosc, Jean Pierre, and Alberto Giuganino. Mostra D'arte Cinese: Catalogo = Exhibition of Chinese Art: Catalogue. Venezia: Alfieri Editore, 1954.（cat. no. 789）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals at upper right:

Beneath the fence yellow [chrysanthemum] flowers brave the rain to blossom;/
Still others lean on the red osmanthus tree and dazzle the deep green moss./
With a goblet [of wine] I face them, entirely without concern;/
Who will answer the knocking at the gate where a guest has arrived?

In the ninth month of the fourth year of the Chenghua era [1468], I followed the brush-conception of Wang Danxuan 王澹軒 [Wang Yuan 王淵] at the Youzhuzhuang 有竹庄 [House with Bamboo].
	Inscribed and [painted] by Shen Zhou 沈周 of Changzhou 長洲. [seals] Shitian 石田; Shen shi Qinan 沈氏启南.

trans. HR
1 additional inscription, dated 1523, and 2 seals of Wang Chong 王寵 (1494-1533).
